blocks.text: Ab hum us mashhoor experiment ko qareeb se dekhte hain jo Thomas Young ne 1801 mein kiya. Is experiment se unhon ne dikhaya ke roshni wave hai. Roshni ki aik beam do parallel slits par dali jati hai jo beam ke perpendicular (90° par) rakhi hoti hain. Roshni har slit se diffract ho kar (mur kar) aage ki jagah mein phailti hai, aur dono slits ki roshni screen par aik doosre ke oopar aati hai. Screen par roshan aur andhere bands (patton) ka interference pattern banta hai; in bands ko 'fringes' kehte hain.

Interference dekhne ke liye waves ke do sets chahiye. Waves ke sources coherent hone chahiye, yani sources se nikalne wali waves ka phase difference constant rahe. Is ka matlab yeh bhi hai ke waves ki wavelength aik jaisi ho. Aaj kal yeh aasani se hota hai: laser ki aik hi beam ko do slits se guzaar dein. Laser tez aur coherent roshni deta hai. Slits se guzarte hue roshni diffract ho kar aage phail jati hai (Fig. 15.8). Ab hamare paas waves ke do sets hain jo aik doosre ke oopar aate hain, aur screen par fringes ka pattern un ke interference ka result dikhata hai. Yeh pattern kaise banta hai? Hum screen ke teen points lete hain (Fig. 15.9 a, b, c) aur dekhte hain ke har point par kya nazar aana chahiye.

blocks.alt: Left side teen khare wavefronts jinhein chaar horizontal gulabi rays kaatti hain, aur yeh do slits S1 aur S2 wali barrier (rukawat) tak pohanchti hain. Barrier ke paar har slit se gol wavefronts phailte hain aur right side screen ki taraf jate hue aik doosre ko kaat-te hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.8: Double slit arrangement (kitab mein Fig. 15.9 chhapa; kitab ki figure ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab is figure ko 'Fig.15.9' likhti hai, lekin text isi ko Fig 15.8 kehta hai aur agli teen hisson wali figure ko Fig 15.9. Is liye yahan ise Figure 15.8 likha hai. Har slit naye source ki tarah gol waves chhorti hai; jahan dono ki waves milti hain wahan interference hota hai.
Point A

Yeh point dono slits ke beech wale point ke bilkul samne hai. A par roshni ki do rays pohanchti hain, aik slit 1 se aur aik slit 2 se. A dono slits se barabar faasle par hai, is liye dono rays ne barabar faasla tay kiya. Dono ka path difference (raste ki lambai ka farq) zero hai. Agar slits se nikalte waqt dono in phase thin to A par bhi in phase pohanchengi. Is liye constructive interference hoga aur A par roshan fringe nazar aayega.
Point B

Yeh point A se thora sa hat kar hai aur pehle andhere fringe ka midpoint (beech) hai. B par bhi har slit se aik aik ray pohanchti hai. Slit 1 ki roshni ko slit 2 ki roshni se thora zyada faasla tay karna parta hai, is liye dono rays ab qadam se qadam nahi milatin. B andhere fringe ke beech mein hai, is liye dono rays antiphase mein hain (phase difference 180°, aik ka crest doosri ke trough par). Dono ka path difference aadhi wavelength hai, is liye destructive interference hota hai.
Point C

Yeh agle roshan fringe ka midpoint hai, aur AB = BC. Yahan bhi ray 1 ne ray 2 se zyada faasla tay kiya; is dafa yeh extra faasla poori aik wavelength λ hai. Ab path difference aik poori wavelength hai, is liye dono rays screen par in phase hain. Constructive interference hota hai aur roshan fringe nazar aata hai. Poora interference pattern isi tarah samjhaya ja sakta hai (Fig. 15.9).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig.15.21' ka hawala (reference) deti hai jo kitab mein hai hi nahi. Points A, B aur C ke roshan aur andhere hisse Fig. 15.9 mein dikhaye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse; har aik mein d faasle par slits S1 aur S2, L faasle par screen, aur dono slits se lehardaar rays. (a) Rays screen ke centre par milti hain: roshan (constructive interference). (b) Oopar milti hain; neeche wali ray aadhi wavelength zyada chalti hai (grey triangle): andhera (destructive). (c) Aur oopar, aik poori wavelength zyada: roshan. Angle theta dikhaya gaya hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.9: (a) θ = 0 par central (beech wala) roshan hissa; (b) pehla andhera hissa; (c) first order (pehle number ka) roshan hissa (kitab ki Figure 15.9 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing; kitab mein (b) aur (c) ke captions ulat gaye hain).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 15.9 ke captions mein panel (b) ko 'first order bright region' aur panel (c) ko 'first dark region' likha hai, lekin drawings ulta dikhati hain: (b) mein extra faasla aadhi wavelength (andhera, destructive) aur (c) mein poori aik wavelength (roshan, constructive) hai. Oopar caption sahi likha gaya hai.

Young ke experiment ka hisaab aasan karne ke liye hum maan lete hain ke slits se screen tak faasla L slits ke darmiyani faasle d ke muqable mein itna bara hai ke S₁ aur S₂ se point P tak jane wali lines taqreeban parallel hain. Roshni ke experiments mein aam taur par aisa hi hota hai: slits ka faasla chand millimetre ya is se kam hota hai, jab ke screen aik metre ya zyada door hoti hai. Phir path difference (raste ki lambai ka farq) yeh hai:
Yahan θ woh angle hai jo slits se screen tak jane wali line aur slits ki plane ke normal (us par perpendicular line, figure mein patli kaali line) ke darmiyan banta hai.
Do slits ka constructive aur destructive interference

Hum parh chuke hain ke constructive interference (waves ka mazboot hona) un points par hota hai jahan path difference wavelength ka integer (poora number) guna ho, yani mλ, jahan m = 0, 1, 2, 3. Is liye screen par roshan hisse (Fig. 15.10) un angles θ par bante hain jin ke liye:

Isi tarah destructive interference (waves ka khatam hona) un points par hota hai jahan path difference half-integer (aadhe wala number), yani (m + ½) wavelengths ho. Wahan screen par andhere hisse bante hain:
Is tarah screen par roshan aur andhere bands aik ke baad aik bante hain, jinhein interference fringes kehte hain; yeh slits S₁ aur S₂ ke parallel hote hain (Fig. 15.9).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke aise pattern ki photograph (tasveer) Fig. 15.9 mein hai. Kitab mein fringes ki koi photograph chhapi hi nahi; Fig. 15.9 sirf rays ki drawings hain (central roshan hissa, pehla andhera hissa, first order roshan hissa). Asal pattern mein roshan aur andhere seedhe bands barabar faasle par hote hain.

blocks.alt: Grey barrier mein do slits, oopar S2 aur neeche S1, d faasle par, aur right side L faasle par screen. Neeli rays r2 aur r1 slits se screen ke point P tak jati hain jo centre line se y neeche hai. Centre line aur ray ke darmiyan angle theta, aur slits par bhi theta; S2 wali ray ka chhota extra hissa d sin theta likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.10: Double slit arrangement ka schematic (saada) khaka (kitab ki Figure 15.10 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.text: Ab hum screen par roshan bands ke centres ki jagah ka formula nikalte hain. Fig. 15.10 mein y pattern ke centre se napa jata hai. Maan lein yₘ pattern ke centre (θ = 0) se m-wein roshan band ke centre tak ka faasla hai, aur θₘ us ka angle hai. To:
Aise experiments mein yₘ aam taur par L se bohat chhota hota hai. Is liye θₘ bohat chhota angle hai, aur chhote angle ke liye sin θₘ taqreeban tan θₘ ke barabar hota hai. Is liye:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 'sin θₘ = tan θₘ' likhti hai. Yeh barabar nahi hote; sirf bohat chhote angle par taqreeban barabar hote hain: sin θₘ ≈ tan θₘ (≈ θₘ radians mein). Maslan 2° par sin = 0.0349 aur tan = 0.0349, lekin 30° par sin = 0.500 aur tan = 0.577. Is liye equations 15.4 aur 15.5 sirf chhote angles ke liye (approximately) sahi hain.
Ab d sin θₘ = mλ (equation 15.2) se sin θₘ = mλ/d rakhein. Chhote angles ke liye m-wein roshan band ki jagah:
Do lagatar (consecutive) roshan ya do lagatar andhere fringes ke centres ka faasla (fringe spacing):

Pattern mein do saath wale roshan bands ka faasla slits ke faasle d ke inversely proportional (ulta tanasub: aik barhe to doosra ghate) hai: d chhota to Δy bara. Slits jitni qareeb hon, pattern utna phailta hai; slits door hon to bands qareeb qareeb aa jate hain.

Humne yeh experiment Young ki tarah visible (nazar aane wali) roshni ke saath bataya, lekin yeh equations har type ki wave par laagu hain, shart yeh hai ke do coherent sources ki resultant wave aise point par pakri jaye jo slits ke faasle d ke muqable mein bohat door ho.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ke 'ssmall' aur 'cosective' spelling ki ghaltiyan hain; matlab 'small' aur 'consecutive' (lagatar) hai.
Hal shuda misal (worked example) (izafi, kitab ki nahi)

blocks.title: Izafi misal
blocks.problem: 600 nm wavelength ki roshni 0.30 mm faasle wali do slits se guzarti hai aur fringes 1.5 m door screen par dekhe jate hain. Fringe spacing Δy maloom karein.
steps: Diya gaya: λ = 600 nm = 600 × 10⁻⁹ m, d = 0.30 mm = 0.30 × 10⁻³ m, L = 1.5 m; maloom karna hai Δy.

blocks.prompt: Slits ke faasle d aur screen ke faasle L se fringes ka faasla y banta hai. Agar d aur L dono dugne kar diye jayen to fringes ka naya faasla kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Δy wahi y rahega: Δy = Lλ/d, aur L aur d dono dugne karne se Lλ/d nahi badalta (2L/2d = L/d). Yeh kitab ka MCQ 15.3 hai; jawab (b) y.

blocks.prompt: Agar Young ka poora saaman pani mein rakh diya jaye to fringes ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Pani mein roshni ki wavelength kam ho jati hai (λ/n, jahan pani ka refractive index n taqreeban 1.33), is liye fringe spacing Lλ/d kam ho jati hai: fringes qareeb qareeb aa jate hain.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Point A: path difference zero, roshan; point B: aadhi wavelength, andhera; point C: poori wavelength, roshan.
Path difference r₂ − r₁ = d sin θ (15.1).
Roshan: d sin θ = mλ (15.2); andhera: d sin θ = (m + ½)λ.
yₘ = L tan θₘ ≈ L sin θₘ = mLλ/d (15.3-15.5, sirf chhote angles ke liye); fringe spacing Δy = Lλ/d (15.6), d ke inversely proportional.
